PM Modi inaugurates multiple redeveloped railway stations across India

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated several redeveloped railway stations across different states in India. The events took place on July 17 and 18, with the Prime Minister virtually inaugurating projects in Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Odisha, and Tamil Nadu. These inaugurations are part of a national plan to modernize railway infrastructure.
